About Us

INDICO is Telkomsel Group’s digital company, focused on developing and scaling digital platforms beyond core connectivity.

As part of Telkomsel Group, INDICO enables collaboration to support end-to-end digital use cases, ranging from customer engagement and transactions to loyalty, commerce, and data intelligence.

Through its platforms, INDICO transforms group capabilities into scalable and repeatable solutions that support Telkomsel’s digital growth and unlock new business opportunities across the ecosystem.

INDICO believe we can reach beyond to empower Indonesians and enable businesses through our strong core values of EPIC WAY (Excellence, Positivity, Impactful Collaboration, Customer First, Walk the Talk, Accountability, Yes-if Mindset).

What you will do but not limited to:

Enterprise Architecture

• Develop and maintain the enterprise architecture blueprint.
• Define business capability maps, application landscape, technology landscape, and integration landscape.
• Drive target-state architecture and modernization roadmaps.
• Establish architecture principles and technology standards.
• Ensure architectural alignment with business objectives and technology strategy.

Solution Architecture

• Lead architecture design for strategic and cross-functional initiatives.
• Review business and product requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
• Define solution architecture, service boundaries, APIs, integration patterns, and non-functional requirements.
• Support engineering teams throughout implementation.
• Review major technical designs and ensure architectural consistency.

Architecture Governance

• Establish and operate the Architecture Review Board (ARB).
• Own architecture governance processes and decision-making.
• Maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADR).
• Review technical risks and approve architecture exceptions.
• Ensure adherence to architecture principles and standards.

Reference Architecture & Standards

• Build reusable reference architectures.
• Define standards for APIs, integrations, cloud, security, observability, and scalability.
• Promote architectural reuse.
• Continuously improve architecture frameworks and best practices.

Technical Leadership

• Mentor engineering teams.
• Facilitate architecture workshops and design reviews.
• Promote architecture thinking.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related field.
• Have minimum 3 years in software engineering.
• Have minimum 3 years in solution architecture, or enterprise architecture.
• Experience with payment platforms, banking integrations, telco systems, API platforms, event-driven architecture, cloud-native architecture, DDD, TOGAF, ArchiMate/C4.
• Strong knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, APIs, cloud platforms, and integration architectures.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. wo-klbf-JR26_000664.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Maintain and continuously update the report of new product/business pipeline and contribution

- Manage the end-to-end process of strategic projects, ensuring seamless communication between internal stakeholders and external partners.
- Manage and optimize the company’s internal innovation management and stage-gate processes

- Assist in daily business development tasks and operations.

- Prepare and review business development reports and documentation.

- Support the business development team in achieving departmental goals.

- Ensure compliance with business standards and regulations.

- Memelihara dan memperbarui secara berkala laporan pipeline produk/bisnis baru beserta kontribusinya

- Mengelola proses end-to-end dari proyek-proyek strategis, serta memastikan kelancaran komunikasi antara pemangku kepentingan internal dan mitra eksternal

- Mengelola dan mengoptimalkan manajemen inovasi internal perusahaan dan proses stage-gate

- Membantu dalam tugas dan operasi harian pengembangan bisnis.

- Menyiapkan dan meninjau laporan dan dokumentasi pengembangan bisnis.

- Mendukung tim pengembangan bisnis dalam mencapai tujuan departemen.

- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar dan regulasi bisnis.

Company:
KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
